links.outcome: Accuracy of LLM detection of clinically significant drug-drug interactions in anesthetic regimens versus Lexicomp
links.effect: ChatGPT accurately identified 76 of 80 clinically significant DDIs (sensitivity 95%); four responses incorrect, omitting additional relevant interactions or comprehensive management recommendations.
links.quote: Across both trials, ChatGPT accurately identified 76 of 80 clinically significant DDIs (sensitivity 95%) with four responses classified as Incorrect.

screen.reason: Evaluates ChatGPT's baseline diagnostic accuracy in detecting drug-drug interactions on synthetic perioperative clinical vignettes against Lexicomp.
